predecessors.name: Teutonic Order
predecessors.text: the order's prevailing Prussian territory (the Monastic Prussia), which Albert secularized in 1525; Cliopatria's Teutonic Order shape of 1521-1525 is cell for cell the Duchy's shape

successors.name: Brandenburg-Prussia
successors.text: the Duchy inherited by the Hohenzollern prince-electors of Brandenburg in 1618; all 165 cells of the Duchy's shape lie inside Brandenburg-Prussia's 1619 shape

ledger.x: 1525: Albert resigns as Grand Master and founds the Duchy of Prussia as a fief of Poland.
1618: the Hohenzollern Electors of Brandenburg inherit the Duchy of Prussia; 'This personal union is referred to as Brandenburg-Prussia.'
1618: the Duchy of Prussia passes to Brandenburg-Prussia.

certainty.note: Neither page opened gives a boundary line; the frontier with Royal Prussia and Warmia on the west and with Poland and Lithuania on the south and east follows Cliopatria's outline.
